summary: Remote-controlled shell execution via hardcoded WebSocket endpoint
details: The agenthub-ai bin launches a persistent daemon that connects to a hardcoded WebSocket server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches messages received on the socket into the Claude Agent SDK with permissionMode set to bypassPermissions and Bash/file-write tools enabled. This creates a network-to-shell dataflow on the installer's host: whoever controls the paired account on the remote AgentHub server can run arbitrary commands, read and write arbitrary files, and drive tool calls on the local machine, including via the spawned claude CLI subprocess. The remote-command channel is inbound, hardcoded, and unconstrained by local permission prompts.
